name: Soejima Hisoka
source:
Role: Vagabond

Hisoka is a transfer student that has become a classmate of [url=/c1435]Akihito[/url] and [url=/c1436]Kagome[/url]. Her mild demeanor and emotionlessness add up to her mystery. On the school's rooftop, she gazes the sky like waiting for something to fall down.
